audit_requests.finding: persistTranslatedPage rejection still allowed completion accounting; subsequent retry handling also lost original restore metadata or could leave DOM/storage out of sync.
audit_requests.current_evidence: Pre-fix run 36959749640 completed the batch after persist_failed. Intermediate runs exposed duplicate persistence, stale DOM after retry, and missing originalUrl/cleanUrl/size metadata.
audit_requests.missing_evidence: A failed persistence must leave the batch active; only a successful retry may account the index, with original metadata and DOM synchronized after persistence success.
audit_requests.why_needed: Persistence is the commit boundary. Counting failed commits or retrying without restore metadata can report false completion and corrupt restore state.
audit_requests.requested_action: Do not account on catch; make retry explicit; preserve metadata; update DOM only after successful retry persistence.
audit_requests.expected_evidence: Failure leaves batch active and silent; retry makes exactly one persistence attempt, preserves restore metadata, updates DOM, then completes once.
audit_requests.expected_auditor_action: Reaudit persistence failure/retry, restore metadata and DOM/storage consistency.
audit_requests.possible_regression: False success after storage failure; duplicate writes; retry loses restore identity or shows content different from persisted content.
audit_requests.impact: Batch correctness, persistence integrity, restore behavior and success audio.

audit_requests.current_evidence: cm-gtc-client.js@b7bb841499a9e677f9709f0c634c648ac6a0f65b: queryGlobalTranslationCache lines 113-119 returns entriesByHash immediately at line 116 whenever GTC_QUERY_MANY is ok, so legacy gtc_<hash> is consulted only when the whole modern request fails. That contract is compatible with fallback-on-MISS and must remain protected.
audit_requests.requested_action: PRIMARY and ADVERSARIAL must independently decide whether the current early-return semantics violate fallback recovery. If CHANGES_REQUIRED is the distributed final decision, implement fallback only for modern misses plus an explicit marker/version for newly-created fallback so newest marked fallback can outrank stale IndexedDB without letting historical legacy overwrite a valid modern hit.
required_cases: fallback mais recente explicitamente marcado -> prevalece sobre IndexedDB stale
legacy histórico não marcado + IndexedDB hit válido -> IndexedDB continua vencendo
audit_requests.expected_evidence: Three executable contracts: modern miss -> legacy hit; newest marked fallback -> stale modern hit; valid modern hit -> unmarked historical legacy does not win. Preserve existing full modern-hit behavior and rerun GTC/content suites.
audit_requests.independence_requirement: Somente auditor independente pode transformar a evidência em CHANGES_REQUIRED; corretor não deve reabrir a unidade por este request.
audit_requests.missing_evidence: Independent regression A: GTC_QUERY_MANY returns ok + entriesByHash missing the requested hash while gtc_<hash> exists; query must return the legacy value. Independent regression B: a fallback created by the newest failed save must beat an older IndexedDB value for the same hash. Independent regression C: an unmarked historical legacy value must NOT overwrite a valid modern IndexedDB hit; existing full-hit zero-legacy behavior may remain.
audit_requests.safe_fix_direction: Do not blindly prefer legacy. Suggested contract: failed GTC_SAVE records the fallback as an explicit recent override (preferably in a dedicated marker/override map) in addition to backward-compatible gtc_<hash>; successful GTC_SAVE clears both. Query overlays only explicit recent overrides on IndexedDB hits, while unmarked legacy fills misses only. This preserves valid modern hits and backward compatibility. This is technical evidence only and does not authorize correction.

correction_plan_if_authorized.goal: Preserve backward-compatible legacy recovery without allowing historical legacy to overwrite a valid modern hit.
correction_plan_if_authorized.storage_marker: On failed GTC_SAVE, write gtc_<hash>=dataUrl plus a companion marker outside the gtc_ prefix, e.g. _mt_gtc_fallback_v1_<hash>={version:1,dataUrl}. Write both in the same storage.local.set call.
correction_plan_if_authorized.successful_modern_save: On successful GTC_SAVE, remove both gtc_<hash> and its companion fallback marker. Per-hash save serialization already prevents older attempts from running after newer ones.
query_algorithm: If the whole modern request fails, preserve current compatibility behavior: read legacy gtc_<hash> for all requested hashes.
If modern request succeeds, read companion markers for requested hashes.
Read raw gtc_<hash> only for hashes missing from entriesByHash or hashes carrying a valid companion marker.
Valid marked fallback matching the raw dataUrl outranks a modern value because it represents a newer failed save.
Unmarked historical legacy is used only when the modern hash is missing; it never overwrites a modern hit.
required_regressions: modern ok + hash miss + unmarked legacy => legacy hit
modern stale hit + matching marked latest fallback => marked fallback wins
modern valid hit + unmarked historical legacy => modern wins
full modern hit with no marker => existing integration contract keeps zero raw gtc_ legacy lookups
successful modern save after fallback => removes raw fallback and companion marker
non_goals: Do not change dHash/perceptual query precedence in this correction.
Do not weaken gtc-indexeddb-deep full-hit assertion.
Do not modify protected source/Bible before distributed CHANGES_REQUIRED.
